notes: result.jsonl is the byte-for-byte output of the authorized lab run (G1.6b) against the lab HTTP(S) origins on the internal lab network; no route off the host.

httpx is given host:port without a scheme (runtime.targetsFormat=host_port); it probes HTTPS first and falls back to HTTP, so .211:443 appears with its TLS certificate (lab CA) and the others without one.

expected.json is the parser output for this raw file and is cross-checked against the inventory-derived origin list (deploy/lab/fixtures/httpx.expected.json): application keys, SERVES edges and the status each origin answers.
